title: Final Fantasy VII
subtitle: Square · 1997
description:
The world has fallen under the control of the Shinra Electric Power Company, a shadowy corporation that controls the planet's very life force as mako energy. In the city of Midgar, an anti-Shinra organization calling themselves Avalanche have stepped up their resistance. Cloud Strife, a former member of Shinra's elite SOLDIER unit now turned mercenary, lends his aid to the group, unaware of the epic consequences that await him.

Follow Cloud and his companions across a world of cities, deserts and ruins as the truth of his past, and of the planet itself, comes apart.
